subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: count to seventy-seven
fact: The party must count to seventy-seven while the figures send a ray of just white through the room to bless their equipment.
source_quote: count to seventy-seven

subject: silver daggers count
fact: Five silver daggers and nineteen silver-tipped arrows were found hidden beneath a loose flagstone.
source_quote: five silver daggers and nineteen silver-tipped arrows

subject: magic dagger and short sword count
fact: A magical dagger and short sword were discovered and distributed to those lacking enchanted weapons.
source_quote: a magical dagger and short sword

subject: sacrifice the traitor
fact: Romag commanded the party to bring Lieutenant Krell to him alive to sacrifice him in the Temple of Earth as a warning.
source_quote: bring the traitor to him alive so he could sacrifice him in the Temple of Earth

subject: Fire Temple gnoll territory
fact: Fire Temple gnolls occupy one area while Earth Temple gnolls hold another, and the rivals periodically clash in brutal combat.
source_quote: Earth Temple gnolls occupied one area while Fire Temple gnolls held another

subject: silver service value
fact: A silver service worth a considerable sum was discovered and divided among the party.
source_quote: a silver service worth a considerable sum

subject: convert to Earth Temple
fact: Calmer declared himself a former cleric of Saint Cuthbert who had converted to the Earth Temple’s cause.
source_quote: a former cleric of Saint Cuthbert who had converted to the Earth Temple’s cause

subject: octagonal room
fact: The party sneaked past the wraith in the octagonal room on their return to Romag.
source_quote: the wraith in the octagonal room

subject: bone-covered hallway
fact: The party moved silently through the bone-covered hallway where skeletal warriors lay waiting to animate.
source_quote: the bone-covered hallway where skeletal warriors lay waiting to animate

subject: set up by Lieutenant Krell
fact: The party was set up by Lieutenant Krell, who led them to kill an Earth Temple ogre disguised as a Fire Temple foe.
source_quote: the ogre was a member of the Earth Temple, not the Fire Temple

subject: plush guest chamber
fact: The party entered a chamber that had once been a plush guest chamber but was now dirty and cluttered.
source_quote: a chamber that had once been a plush guest chamber but was now dirty and cluttered

subject: bunk rooms
fact: The party rested in the bunk rooms with the other guards after their mission.
source_quote: the bunk rooms with the other guards

subject: holy symbols of Saint Cuthbert and Rao
fact: Holy symbols of Saint Cuthbert and Rao were found among the hidden treasure pile.
source_quote: holy symbols of Saint Cuthbert and Rao

subject: wager on party survival
fact: Dick Rentsch had wagered the party would not survive their mission.
source_quote: Dick Rentsch had apparently wagered they would not survive

subject: Temple of Earth
fact: Romag declared the party would have a place among his followers in the Temple of Earth.
source_quote: have a place among his followers

subject: angelic trap
fact: The party avoided the angelic trap involving crystal windows, silvered items, and blessings.
source_quote: avoided the angelic trap

subject: werewolf ambush
fact: The party encountered werewolves in a room with nesting heaps of cloth and pillows, bones and litter, and rust-red cloaks.
source_quote: werewolves who snarled at the intruders, their eyes gleaming with predatory intelligence

subject: enchanted weapons
fact: Calmer enchanted Sequioa’s short sword and Zinnia’s spear with magical properties.
source_quote: channeling energy to temporarily enchant Sequioa’s short sword and Zinnia’s spear

subject: mace of smiting
fact: Calmer wielded his mace of smiting during the battle against the werewolves.
source_quote: Calmer wielded his mace of smiting

subject: secret entrance
fact: Zinnia’s keen eyes spotted a secret entrance leading to the werewolves’ lair.
source_quote: Zinnia’s keen eyes spotted a secret entrance

subject: hidden treasure pile
fact: A loose flagstone concealed a hidden treasure pile containing silver pieces, holy symbols, silver daggers, and silver-tipped arrows.
source_quote: a loose flagstone that concealed a hidden treasure pile

subject: betrayal by Lieutenant Krell
fact: Lieutenant Krell betrayed the party by sending them to kill an Earth Temple ogre.
source_quote: someone had set them up, and the most likely culprit was Lieutenant Krell himself

subject: Romag’s chamber
fact: The party returned to Romag’s chamber to report the betrayal and receive their new mission.
source_quote: returned to Romag to explain what had happened

subject: raid Fire Temple
fact: The party was tasked with raiding the Fire Temple to tip the balance in the Earth Temple’s favor.
source_quote: raid them, killing as many as they could without getting themselves killed
